phase: Phase 10 section B — nonlinear transport (the plan B) + H6 positive control
question: Does role transport exist at the answer position (and P-path binding sites) that a LINEAR operator misses? The Phase 8C/9 negative is explicitly scoped to linear maps; this tests the map-class boundary.
battery: phase10/nonlinear/nl_transport_lib.py — PCA-r reduction (basis on pooled TRAIN x), map classes {linear, mlp, kernel}, relative transport error (identity scores 1) in the reduced space.

map_classes.linear: ridge anchor (incumbent); the existing linear result restricted to the PCA subspace
map_classes.kernel: RBF kernel ridge, bandwidth = median pairwise distance

conditions.C1: fit on fit-vocab TRAIN, eval on transfer-vocab TEST (disjoint vocabulary) — mandatory
conditions.C2: fit on path-P TRAIN, eval on path-G TEST (cross-path) — mandatory at the answer position (8C cache has both paths); UNAVAILABLE at P-path binding sites

nulls: shuffled-pair (Y rows permuted), 10 seeds, matched regime; FPR 0.05 -> tau = 0.05-quantile of null errors (lt).

decision_rule_frozen.reveals_nonlinear_transport: a class beats BOTH identity (1.0) AND the linear anchor AND the shuffled null tau, on C1 AND C2, at some capacity tier
decision_rule_frozen.B6_capacity_curve: the claim attaches to the LOWEST passing tier; success only at the top tier -> reported as memorisation-consistent, not transport
decision_rule_frozen.B7_name_support: any linear-or-nonlinear success is checked for concentration in the name-readout subspace; concentrated -> vocabulary-bound, not abstract role
decision_rule_frozen.B5_same_path_only: a class passing C1 but not C2 (answer position) -> path-local nonlinear structure, explicitly NOT the original role algebra
decision_rule_frozen.precondition_H6: the nonlinear battery MUST first recover a PLANTED nonlinear role code (H6) that the linear battery FAILS, at the Stage-1 SNRs. If H6 fails, B is uninterpretable and is not read.

H6_construction.organism: S-role-nonlinear: Stage-1 S-role states h_lin(x) passed through a FIXED smooth invertible nonlinearity phi(z) = O^T psi(O z), O fixed random orthogonal (d x d), psi(u) = u + tanh(2u) elementwise (monotonic -> invertible; role info preserved).
H6_construction.alpha_fixed_a_priori: psi = u + tanh(2u); NOT tuned against the outcome
H6_construction.controls: S-role (linear; both linear and nonlinear batteries must recover) and S-retrieval (neither recovers) run alongside
H6_construction.pass_criterion: on S-role-nonlinear: linear anchor FAILS C1 (err >= linear-recovers bar, i.e. not below identity by the FPR margin) while some MLP tier RECOVERS (err beats identity, linear, and null) at SNR in {10,3}; on S-role: linear recovers (Stage-1 E1 replicates); on S-retrieval: nothing recovers.

real_targets.answer_position: results/phase8a_final/acts/ (8C cache, both paths, both vocabs; C1 and C2 available)
real_targets.binding_sites_P: acts_P_local/ (Phase 9 P cache; C1 available, C2 UNAVAILABLE — no G binding-site cache; capped: no H_role language possible there)

verification: config frozen (sha recorded) before real-cache test reads; H6 gates B; single evaluation per (target, condition, tier).
